claimBoundary: Frozen synthetic campaigns on a world written by the adversarial review. Both methods were named before the world existed and both failed: refusal prevented 0 of 925-961 critical errors on trios and refused all 2,400 decisions in a family the baseline settles correctly; the composite made 342-439 false merges with zero true ones where one shock satisfied both of its signals, and never beat refusal on cost. Behaviour does not separate a shared source from a shared shock: joint-error rates were 0.38-0.42 for dependent pairs and 0.58 for the independent shocked pair. Reversible decisions only; no real-world rates; same control domain; no authority claim.
